completion_basis: R1-R4 implementation packets, independent focused tests, the permitted CPU/mock suite, static checks, exact-head GitHub CI, and an independent affected-scope Sentinel all pass. The remaining V28/V29 closure entries are closed by this V30 descendant; no production execution or unmeasured runtime claim is made.

remaining_fixes.title: Transactional generation-manifest reconciliation
remaining_fixes.summary: Manifest reconciliation validates only an appended delta, publishes candidate state only after complete validation, and rejects non-prefix or corrupt external changes without partially mutating the in-memory store.
remaining_fixes.runtime_effect: Removes repeated historical JSONL validation from normal commits while retaining a final O(K) integrity check and O(delta) external reconciliation.

remaining_fixes.title: One-time validated explanation source identity
remaining_fixes.summary: Production explanation resolution writes and validates a source receipt after one physical checkpoint verification; later artifact-only stages validate the receipt signature and metadata without rehashing or loading the checkpoint payload.
remaining_fixes.runtime_effect: Removes repeated multi-GB checkpoint hashing from artifact-only explanation stages and keeps the source boundary fail-closed.

remaining_fixes.title: Canonical checkpoint files with tiny selection pointers
remaining_fixes.summary: Modern checkpoint writes use immutable canonical epoch files plus atomic latest/best JSON pointers with exact path, epoch, SHA, sidecar, provenance, variant, and metric validation; legacy paths remain readable.
remaining_fixes.runtime_effect: Avoids duplicate large latest/best checkpoint copies while preserving resume, rollback, approval, and export semantics.

remaining_fixes.title: Exact artifact reuse and resume classification
remaining_fixes.summary: Reuse decisions require exact binding across system, run, seed, checkpoint, config, dataset, model, tokenizer, code, source, approval, epoch, and checkpoint kind; paused work can resume, while uncertain or conflicting bindings block.
remaining_fixes.runtime_effect: Prevents false reuse and gives no time credit unless the complete provenance binding is exact.

v30_reuse_credit.basis: The balanced profile is policy-only, default-off, execution-prohibited, and contains no persisted V30 run receipts. Historical blocked rows are not converted into V30 status or savings.

report_binding.exact_source_head_semantics: The exact source/PR head reviewed by CI and Sentinel. The eventual closure commit contains reports only and does not alter this implementation head.
